shots.action: Coffee tips over a keyboard. Rae hits UNDO. Liquid pulls back into the mug in a physically coherent reverse motion. No title card.
Rae watches the perfectly full mug, then LOOP's quiet indicator. Facial reaction followed by an unhurried reply.
Phone shows an embarrassing sent message addressed to Boss: LOVE YOU. Rae raises the remote.

dialogue.speaker: RAE
dialogue.text: Even that text to my boss?

shots.action: Rae taps UNDO at 0:08. Phone shows MESSAGE UNSENT; a workplace card then changes to APPLICATION REVOKED. First collateral damage is visible around 0:08–0:10, and the comic payoff is complete before 0:15.

shots.framing: Repeated angle matched across time change
shots.action: Rae slaps UNDO again. Jump cut: blinds close, clock rewinds, his clothing changes to pajamas, and an alarm goes off. Show the transformation as deliberate stepping on twos.
He stares at the remote. The cup hovers on the edge. Annoyed, Rae addresses the remote itself.

dialogue.speaker: RAE
dialogue.text: Undo the dumbest thing I bought today.

shots.action: Remote screen selects PURCHASE: UNDO REMOTE. The object disappears. LOOP's indicator stays on (LOOP is a separate smart-home system).
Original coffee spill reappears, flowing across the keyboard. A phone notification from BOSS reads LOVE YOU TOO. Focus on the phone, then Rae.
Rae looks at the ruined keyboard, then at the phone. No music under the pause. Hard cut immediately after his line.
